name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project is one of the country's largest undeveloped precious-metals deposits, with a completed Definitive Feasibility Study and all key environmental permits secured. The company is targeting a Final Investment Decision and first production by 2029.
